children: Canada steel structure fabricator's Q2 revenue rose 79.3% yr/yr
Q2 net income increased, but results were hit by non-cash share unit expenses and FX losses
Gross margin narrowed to 18.7% from 20.7% a year earlier
ADF Group continues to operate amid ongoing Canada-U.S. tariff discussions
Company is focusing on liquidity management and order backlog growth
ADF Group is integrating Groupe LAR and expanding its Quebec plant
ORDER BACKLOG GROWTH - Revenue increase attributed to higher order backlog, with backlog at record high as of July 31, 2026
HIGHER INPUT COSTS - Gross margin narrowed due to higher input costs, particularly steel prices, and recent changes in customs duties
NON-CASH EXPENSES - Results were negatively affected by non-cash items related to share units and foreign exchange losses
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the iron & steel peer group is "hold."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for ADF Group Inc is C$21.00, about 40% above its September 9 closing price of C$15.00
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 7 three months ago
